annotations.title: Authorize a spending budget for an account

description: Funder-signed EIP-712 AgentWalletAuthorization: lets an account spend up to max_units of USDC (6-decimal units, e.g. '1000000' = $1) with an optional daily cap, without giving away the wallet. Requires PHANTOM_FUNDER_PRIVATE_KEY in the environment; the signature is produced locally. Policy templates: 'micro' ($1/tx, $5/day, 30d) and 'subscriptions' ($2/tx, $5/day, 30d) — pilot caps kept deliberately low; explicit max_units/daily_cap_units/expires_in_days override any template. The account's own api_key is sent as authentication (first binding requires it).

account_id.description: IDPHANTOM account that will spend the budget (e.g. acc_...).

api_key.description: Account api_key to authenticate the call; defaults to the server's PHANTOM_API_KEY.

daily_cap_units.description: Optional explicit daily cap in 6-decimal units; overrides the template.

expires_in_days.description: Validity window in days (default from template; max 365).

max_units.description: Explicit per-tx cap in 6-decimal units; overrides the template.

nonce.description: Unique nonce per funder (default: current timestamp in ms); replays return 409.

policy_template.description: Named pilot policy (default 'micro'); use 'custom' with explicit caps.

name: phantom_authorize_budget

text.description: Response body of the IDPHANTOM API as a JSON string.

isError.description: True when the API call failed; text carries { error: { code, message } }.
